P1.established: Input: list of lowercase string tags; Output: single team name string.

P2.established: Known tags: account, billing, privacy. Single known tag -> same name team. Order and duplicate count of known tags do not change the request outcome.

P3.established: Mixed known/unknown tags or overlapping known tags are possible. Classification must follow defined conventions.

H1.established: Priority order: privacy > billing > account. If multiple known tags exist, return the first one in this order.

H2.established: If unknown tags are mixed with known tags, ignore unknown tags.

H3.established: If billing, account, and privacy are all present, route to privacy.

H4.established: If billing and account overlap (without privacy), route to billing.
